lockHelp.title: How Lock works
lockHelp.line1: Predictions close 15 minutes before a Match starts.
lockHelp.line2: If everyone has predicted earlier, it locks right then.
lockHelp.line3: At Lock, everyone's Predictions are revealed. A Lock is never undone.

loadFailed.title: Couldn't load Matches
loadFailed.body: Check your connection and try again. Predictions you already made are not affected.

empty.title: No Matches yet
empty.body: Matches appear once the data source publishes this Event's schedule.
